request: Loan EMI: amount, yearly interest rate, months. Show monthly payment and total interest paid. I'd like it to fetch today's bank rates too.

checklist.item: inputs for amount, annual rate and months

program:
app "EMI" calc ocean
state amount num = 450000
state rate num = 12
state months num = 24
field amount "Loan amount"
field rate "Yearly interest %"
field months "Months"
let interest = amount * rate / 100 * months / 12
"Monthly payment" round((amount + interest) / max(months, 1)) big
"Total interest paid" round(interest) faint
describe:
EMI, in the ocean colours.
Works out:
- interest is amount times rate divided by 100 times months divided by 12.
Remembers while you use it: amount, starting at 450000; rate, starting at 12; months, starting at 24.
Shows:
- a box to fill in amount, labelled "Loan amount".
- a box to fill in rate, labelled "Yearly interest %".
- a box to fill in months, labelled "Months".
- text: "Monthly payment", the result of amount plus interest divided by the larger of months and 1 rounded.
- text: "Total interest paid", interest rounded.

request: Rent collection from 5 flats: tenant, flat no, rent, due day, paid/not paid, electricity bill share. total expected vs collected this month pls

checklist.item: can add a tenant with flat number and rent
shows total expected vs total collected

program:
app "Rent collection" home slate
table tenant name text, flat text, rent money, due_day num 1..31 = 1
table paid tenant ref tenant, amount money
let expected = sum(tenant.rent)
let got = sum(paid.amount month)
goal got, expected, "collected this month"
each tenant sort due_day as t
  let ok = count(t.paid month) > 0
  row card gap 2
    stack grow
      t.name bold
      t.flat faint
    if ok
      "Paid" color good bold
    else
      button "Got rent" tap add paid tenant = t, amount = t.rent
remind "Rent day" monthly on 1 at 10:00
form tenant, "Add tenant"
describe:
Rent collection, in the slate colours.
Keeps:
- tenant: name: text; flat: text; rent: money; due day: number, 1 to 31, starts at 1. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
- paid: tenant: a tenant; amount: money. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Works out:
- expected is the total rent of tenant.
- got is the total amount of paid this month.
Shows:
- got out of expected with a progress bar, labelled "collected this month".
- for each tenant sorted by due day:
  - text: the name of the tenant.
  - text: the flat of the tenant.
  - if ok:
    - text: "Paid".
  - otherwise:
    - a button "Got rent"; a tap adds a paid with tenant set to the tenant, amount set to the rent of the tenant.
- a form to add a tenant.
Reminder "Rent day" every month on day 1 at 10:00.
